notes.title: Square Route - Version 1.1.3 Released
notes.content:
A minor update:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved graphics for "crumbling" tiles.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the level editor warned about losing changes when exiting, even when nothing had changed.
[*] Improved gamepad support.
[/list]

notes.title: Square Route Level Editor Released
notes.content:
We're happy to say that Square Route version 1.1.0 has been released with a brand new level editor and full integration with the Steam workshop!

The level editor can be accessed from the main menu and allows you to create a new level, manage your own levels and play levels created by others. We've created three levels to get you on your way - feel free to play them, rate them and comment on them. All level components available in the main game are available in the editor.

We'd love to see what you come up with!

notes.title: Square Route Version 1.0.2 Released
notes.content:
Made some user interface improvements, including changing the font. Also made a few minor fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed issue on level select screen where levels viewed in upside down mode weren't entirely upside down.
[*]Spades used to destroy bricks (as oppose to platforms) now count towards the achievement for number of spades used.
[*]Improved some animations at lower frame rates.
[/list]
We've also released the game on the iOS App Store for iPad! You can check it out here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/square-route/id1483514455?ls=1

notes.title: Square Route Version 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
Quick update with a couple of fixes:
[list]
[*]Improved the handling of screen resolutions and setting full screen which should prevent a rare issue where the game couldn't change resolution.
[*]Fixed issue where ladders hitting a ceiling could cause an error on some levels.
[*]Minor UI improvements to in-game buttons.
[/list]
Thanks, and enjoy!

notes.title: Square Route is here!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Square Route has now been released on Steam! We'll be monitoring the community hub and forums for a while, so if you have any questions, just ask.

Enjoy!
